title: HB1072 (2026 Regular): Right to Firearm Possession & Elimination of Extreme Risk Protection Orders

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Colorado) (gun-policy Stage 5, Colorado); NO BILL TEXT READ: operative words taken by a fill agent from the legislature's own bill summary (Colorado) (Bill Summary (as introduced; no bill text read); read 2026-11-19; legislature bill page, https://leg.colorado.gov/bills/hb26-1072)

operative_text: Staff summary: The bill codifies an individual's right to own, possess, and use a firearm to the maximum extent permissible by the state and federal constitutions. Extreme risk protection orders and temporary extreme risk protection orders are repealed.
